title: OSINT — How and Why to Do a Reverse Image Search
skills: use reverse image search to investigate the origin of an image
verify whether an image has been reused or taken out of context
evaluate visual evidence for authenticity and credibility
apply digital verification strategies during online research
alignment_note: Introduces reverse image searching as a digital-verification technique for tracing image origins, identifying reuse, and checking context. Supports visual media literacy, source verification, fact-checking, online research, and responsible evaluation of digital evidence across high school English courses.
